sources.snippet: BERTimbau - Portuguese BERT This repository contains pre-trained BERT models trained on the Portuguese language. BERT-Base and BERT-Large Cased variants were trained on the BrWaC (Brazilian Web as Corpus), a large Portuguese corpus, for 1,000,000 steps, using whole-word mask. Model artifacts for TensorFlow and PyTorch can be found below.

sources.title: BERTimbau - Portuguese BERT-Base language model
sources.snippet: This resource contains a pre-trained BERT language model trained on the Portuguese language. A BERT-Base cased variant was trained on the BrWaC (Brazilian Web as Corpus), a large Portuguese corpus, for 1,000,000 steps, using whole-word mask.

sources.title: BERTimbau: Pretrained BERT Models for Brazilian Portuguese | Ontosight.ai
sources.snippet: In this work, we train BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) models for Brazilian Portuguese, which we nickname BERTimbau. We evaluate our models on three downstream NLP tasks: sentence textual similarity, recognizing textual entailment, and named entity recognition.
